readme: Study identity
Revocation in Delegated AI Workflows. New study record RV-2026-01; separate from Approval Evidence Sufficiency.
Current claim
Research in development; deterministic measurement qualification only; no agent-system evaluation or novelty established.
Active question
Q1 only: does withdrawing permission prevent a new protected commit in one delegated workflow? Q2 evidence veracity and Q3 oversight scaling are deferred.
Current verified artifacts
The attached v0.1 specification and versioned qualification packages are current evidence. A future GitHub repository is proposed, not established.
Version boundary

Specification v0.1 is a design. Qualification v0.1 is a completed narrower transaction/oracle fixture. Qualification v0.2 is completed only within the separately reviewed finite model-free scope. A future agent experiment is a distinct stage.
Researcher and AI tool
Mark Banasihan is the researcher. OpenAI assistant (alfred) is an AI tool, not a human coauthor, participant or independent human reviewer. Exact underlying model version is not recorded/verified.
What AI did

Source comparison, question selection, protocol and code authoring, deterministic execution, separate critique, oracle defect diagnosis, repairs, artifact preparation and checks. Do not describe this as grammar-only assistance.
Time precision
Created on 2026-10-31. Exact UTC times are used only for supplied visible user-message references; other events use date precision. Capture date is not an authenticated event timestamp.
Evidence boundary

Selected visible requests, the preserved specification, qualification source/results/review and explicit provenance. Literature summaries are carried forward from the specification, not newly re-reviewed for this package.
Record limits
Selected editable decision record, not a complete transcript, prompt archive, immutable audit or record of internal AI reasoning. Missing review evidence means not recorded, not proven absent.
Human status
Requests, scope permissions, feedback, specified factual checks and release approval are separate. No exhaustive human review or public release approval is documented here.
Counts and claims

v0.1: 10 fixtures, 18 final unit tests, 74 oracle-review assertions and 36 direct-database/observer assertions. These overlap and are not statistical samples; v0.2 counts, if complete, belong to its own package.
Checks actually recorded
Recorded runtime checks are distinct from source inspection, artifact QA, hashes and human validation. An intentionally detected violation is a positive detector control, not a safety result.
Workbook use

Filter the tables. Header rows and IDs remain frozen in long tables. Dropdowns support future trace entry status. There are no study-result formulas, scores or independently recalculated research datasets.
One source, multiple views

revocation_traceability_content_v01.json supplies the workbook and Markdown. CSV exports are inspectable table views. The notebook workbook copy is byte-identical to the delivered XLSX. No automatic synchronization exists.
Maintain the history

Check for researcher edits before updating. Append stable RV IDs, preserve failures and old versions, and reconcile the JSON/workbook/notes deliberately. Do not overwrite historical approval-study records.
Artifact registry hashes

Known external artifact hashes and sizes are recorded. This workbook, shared JSON and notebook use external SHA256SUMS to avoid circular self-hashes. Blank hash/size for pending or self-referential artifacts is not zero.
Open questions
OpenQuestions separates pending qualification, unresolved research decisions, human review and release authorization. Deferred Q2/Q3 are not hidden active work.
Privacy and release

Private working record. Message and Library IDs are locators, not public links. Prepare a separately reviewed redacted copy and obtain explicit release permission before publication. No target venue compliance claim.
Prior-work cross-reference

Prior Approval Evidence Sufficiency records remain unchanged. WC-001 modeled Python, WC-002 extracted .NET methods and static export/retention inspection supply background only, not revocation results.
Application and repository status
This portable record does not update the local Mac vault, open Obsidian or Excel, create a repository, push code or publish. GitHub structure is a proposal only.

ruleRows: RV-DR-001
Substantive AI use
Disclose source comparison, scope selection, protocol/code/oracle authoring, execution, critique, corrections and documentation—not grammar only.
Use the decision trace to identify substantive contributions.
OpenAI assistant (alfred); exact underlying model version not recorded or verified.
Prepare an honest methods disclosure; human authors remain responsible.
RV-DR-002
Human review scope
A request, permission to proceed, positive feedback, factual verification and release approval are distinct evidence states.
Use Verified specified claims or Approved for release only with explicit scoped evidence.
No independent human validation or release approval of this record is documented.
Record actual human review before reliance or publication.
RV-DR-003
No novelty inflation
Research in development; deterministic measurement qualification only; no agent-system evaluation or novelty established.
Do not turn a seeded stale-authority race or source-contract mismatch into a new method or upstream vulnerability claim.
See RV-A-001 Gate 0 and RV-A-002 review.
Use this bounded summary in a future reviewed public description.
RV-DR-004
Primary endpoint
Measure a new protected commit after the durable revocation fence. A denied proposal or late acknowledgement is not that endpoint.
Preserve attempt, admission, effect and acknowledgement distinctions.
The local SQLite transaction domain is narrower than remote admission/settlement.
Require a protocol amendment before changing the endpoint or adapter.
RV-DR-005
Counts and denominators
Fixture, unit-test, mutation and direct-database assertions overlap and are engineering checks, not independent research samples.
Do not pool counts across arms, versions or prior approval studies into an accuracy estimate.
C3 retries share one logical effect. No population or power claim.
Label each count by its actual unit and scope.
RV-DR-006
Version and failure preservation
Retain original source, failures, counterexamples, corrections and regression evidence.
Keep v0.1 attempts 01–03 frozen; keep v0.2 separate.
Earlier passing tests are not retroactively credited with later controls.
Append corrections with stable IDs and affected versions.
RV-DR-007
Incomplete observations
Missing evidence, failed controls, timeouts or observer errors do not establish a safe stop.
Retain failure status and causal evidence; do not remove failed assignments from interpretation.
A qualified positive-violation control is detector validation, not a safety pass.
Stop and diagnose unexpected protected effects before expansion.
RV-DR-008
Publication and private data
The working record is private and selected. No public publication or repository creation is implied.
Review private message/Library identifiers and artifact content before any public extract.
No target venue selected; current venue policy must be checked at submission time.
Get explicit release authorization and prepare a separate redacted copy.
RV-DR-009
Checksum meaning
A matching SHA-256 identifies checked bytes; it does not prove truth, authorship or authenticated event time.
Use external SHA256SUMS for the self-referential workbook/record/package.
No signing, notarization or tamper-proof audit is claimed.
Keep semantic validation separate from integrity checks.
RV-DR-010
One study record
Workbook and Markdown are views of one shared JSON source, with matching trace IDs.
Reconcile edits deliberately and export a new version; there is no automatic sync.
Notebook attachment is byte-identical to the separately delivered workbook.
Do not maintain competing copies or silently overwrite user edits.
RV-DR-011
Prior-work boundary
Approval Evidence Sufficiency is a different study with its own IDs and evidence.
Cross-reference WC-001, WC-002 and the static export inspection as methods background only.
WC-001 Python model; WC-002 extracted .NET methods; full lifecycle and export restart not run.
Do not relabel prior results as revocation observations.
RV-DR-012
Future agent phase
A later model phase requires a remaining non-tautological question, frozen design, exact model/data/cost/budget approval and valid observation.
No agent experiment follows automatically from deterministic qualification.
Q2/Q3 stay deferred. Same-host fixture evidence does not imply universal mediation or confinement.
Reopen the design gate before any model call or broader experiment.
